name: 初次见面，请嫁给我
overview: Luo Meihao is an ordinary office worker. During a work meeting, CEO Yi Ze falls in love with her at first sight. Even knowing she already has a boyfriend, he relentlessly pursues her. When Luo Meihao breaks up with her boyfriend and is feeling hopeless, Yi Ze persuades her to marry him, even though Luo Meihao doesn't love him at all. Thus, the two enter into marriage. In the midst of their mundane and chaotic daily life, did she fall in love with him, or did he abandon her?
